claude_proposed_widenings.name: stored_spell_battery_magic_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Reserve variant needs an item to accept third-party spell casts into storage, track spell-level capacity, preserve the original caster's slot/DC/attack bonus/ability, and later release those stored spells through the wearer. No existing magic-item mechanics family or composition expresses inbound storage plus later release of arbitrary stored payloads.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Any creature can cast a spell of level 1 through 4 into the stone by touching it as the spell is cast... While this stone orbits your head, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: triggered_reaction spell-level-capped cancellation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Absorption and Greater Absorption variants need a reaction that cancels only triggering spells at or below a fixed spell level, without making a save or attack roll. The current reaction surface has negate_triggering_spell, but no way to gate that effect by triggering spell level.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can take a Reaction to cancel a spell of level 4 or lower cast by a creature you can see" / "cancel a spell of level 8 or lower"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: generic charge spend tied to triggering spell level
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Absorption variants deplete by cumulative canceled spell levels, not by flat uses. Current variable charge spending is limited to grant_spell_access. These reactions need activation/resource plumbing where the cost equals the triggering spell's level and burnout occurs when the pool is exhausted.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Once the stone has canceled 20 levels of spells, it burns out"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_proficiency_bonus
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Mastery variant modifies the wielder's Proficiency Bonus directly. That is broader than any existing roll modifier atom and affects multiple derived mechanics, so it cannot be modeled honestly as a bundle of current grants.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Your Proficiency Bonus increases by 1 while this pale green prism orbits your head"
